scope.description: One instance held committed at three replicas on the captured snapshot, each applied through Exec.executeCommand with a GET probe reading the instance's key from the replicated store.
assumptions: each replica's record for the instance is COMMITTED and its dependencies are already satisfied locally
the key is the one the committed commands touch
excluded: the production executeCommands loop, watermark advancement and the recovery timeout
the history that produced each committed record

properties.reason: Independent applicability, correlated prerequisites and fully observed result comparison

adaptations: harness-only scaffolding: Replica values are constructed in-package, per-peer buffers replace the transport, and the recovery and execution are entered directly (startRecoveryForInstance, Exec.executeCommand) instead of through the execution loop; the handlers, executor and state application are unmodified
prepared history: the already-committed record is installed directly, as in the earlier checks

plan_uncertainties: The harness applies records directly with Exec.executeCommand, so scheduling, watermark advancement and the recovery timeout are outside this check.
